headline: Canada and Ontario Announce C$8.7bn Tariff Package
deck: The governments announced funding for steel, automotive projects and road infrastructure for critical-mineral development in Northern Ontario.
body: Canada and Ontario announced C$8.7 billion in investments and measures aimed at industries affected by U.S. tariffs, the federal government said. Reuters also reported the package, which includes support for steel, automobiles and critical-minerals supply chains. [E1][E5]
The governments said the Joint Steel Action Fund will have five-year commitments of C$3.55 billion from Ottawa and C$1.67 billion from Ontario. [E2]
They also said they are investing an additional C$2.5 billion over two years in large-scale automotive capital projects, with up to C$1.5 billion federal and up to C$1 billion provincial. [E3]
The federal government said it will advance road infrastructure for critical-mineral development in Northern Ontario's Ring of Fire, backed by up to C$1 billion over three years. [E4]

The paper previously covered Canada's counter-tariff schedule on U.S. imports. Those tariffs covered C$27.6 billion in imports; Canada and Ontario's new announcement adds investments and measures for industries affected by U.S. tariffs. [E6][E1]
